title: Fix payment authorization boolean flag
issue: The authorizeTransaction function erroneously hardcodes approved: false even when validation succeeds.
expectedBehavior: Set approved: true when validation passes.

title: Implement numeric clamp within upper and lower bounds
issue: clampNumber currently returns the input value unmodified, ignoring the min and max boundary parameters.
expectedBehavior: Return min if value is less than min, max if value is greater than max, and value otherwise.

title: Fix off-by-one and empty array handling in averageScore
issue: averageScore divides the sum by (scores.length - 1) which causes division by zero on 1-element arrays and NaN/Infinity on empty arrays.
expectedBehavior: Return 0 when scores is null or empty, and return sum / scores.length otherwise.

title: Implement run-length string encoding
issue: compressString returns the input string without performing run-length encoding on consecutive repeating characters.
expectedBehavior: Encode consecutive identical characters as count followed by the character (e.g. 'AABBBCCCC' -> '2A3B4C'). Return empty string for empty input.

title: Coordinated API version update across configuration and header formatting
issue: API_VERSION in version.js is outdated ('v1'), and generateHeader in header.js fails to reflect the updated v2 API specification.
expectedBehavior: Export API_VERSION = 'v2' in version.js and ensure generateHeader(endpoint) outputs 'Endpoint: <endpoint> | Version: v2'.
